_doc: Revision log of the ST185-harness drawing set (every harness of the car) (DECISIONS R200): DRAWN = the BY of Rev A and never changes; every BY is the initials of the person who REQUESTED the change (from %USERPROFILE%\.drawing-initials), never an agent or tool name. .01 clerical revs are not rows here (git history only). A full-letter rev from Rev B on lists what changed in `marks` (the rev triangle goes next to each).
title: ST185-harness - every wiring harness of the car, one drawing set
subtitle: All 12 harnesses of the master wire list (R221): the ECU harness (AB-cabin + AB-engine, R220), CabinPower, harness C, HeavyDC, CAN, CSB3, AntiTheft, ClusterLED, wheel speed front / rear, rear fuel. Rear lights stay on the factory harness.

revs.what: First issue: every harness of the master in one drawing set (replaces the ST185-AB-cabin pilot, Rev A 2026-10-19).
Surgical rewire written into the master: 21 decided circuits, D16 A/C, OEM starter / reverse / rear lights, fog cut-and-cap, bank IDs, RearLights harness dropped.
revs.marks: starter C11 to Aux 8; k_acc from A15 pin 8; Ign 8 tacho; EL814 headlight-sense; w_pdb_jb1 behind the dash; E10 cabin splice; R/B2 and R/B4 feeds

revs.what: A15 lock-sensor input takes a modified tacho: Ign 8 through 4.7 kΩ to pin 9 (N61 workaround).
Car-check answers: if the ignition-switch black-orange wire is at the engine plug, remove it; A/C sensor common stays; J/B1 feed sized 6 AWG for 60 A.
C11 is hardware starter interlock only; Aux 8 spare. Oil LED stays on CSB3 L4.
revs.marks: w_str85 removed; Aux 8 spare; oil LED CSB3 L4

revs.what: Each grouped section is its own page. A schematic page holds six wires, each in its own line colour; the label keeps the wire's gauge and colour. A crossing bumps over the other wire. Layout pages are the approved route drawings, including Routes 16 and 17 on 1993 EWD p.36 (Dan 2026-10-26 keep).
revs.marks: section pages; six-wire schematic; Routes 16 and 17

revs.what: Layout: the old Routes 2-7 (harness C, A / B engine, A / B cabin, cabin power) were wrong and are removed (Dan 2026-10-26). Route 16 and 17 and Routes 1, 8-14 stay; AB-cabin and CabinPower fall back to the physical tree.
